highlights_led_by_exploit_ready_vulns: Two-year old Oracle WebLogic Server vulnerability is being exploited and Russian hackers exploit WinRAR vulnerability for data theft. Treat newly published PoCs and early exploitation signals as immediate patch/mitigation triggers for internet-facing and fleet-wide infrastructure.
endpoint_posture_under_pressure: Over 116,000 Mincraft systems infected in WeedHack malware campaign. Tighten EDR coverage, block known IoCs where available, and validate software supply-chain integrity in build and CI/CD.
identity_and_edge_access_risks: 'Dumbass' criminal breaks the 'first rule of ransomware club'. Prioritize MFA enforcement, phishing-resistant authentication, and reduce management-plane exposure for edge services and remote access.
